title: Find Circular Gift Exchange Chains
summary: SecretSanta(giver_id,receiver_id,gift_value) records directed gifts with unique giver/receiver pairs. Find circular exchange chains where every participating employee gives to and receives from exactly one other participant. Report chain_length and total_gift_value, deduplicating identical result pairs across chains. Order by length descending then value descending. Confirm whether the one-in/one-out restriction applies globally or within a candidate chain.
